note: Prompts from model-check-skill-notes/14-skill-building-plan.md §8.2 (E1–E6). Each eval has 'assertions' (plan §8.2 as amended; 'expectations' is the key of grading.json only). Every assertion has a 'text' for the human reader and a 'check' a grader applies without judgement: regex / not_regex / regex_order run over the answer text (Python re, flags given in the pattern); petri_json_valid looks for a JSON file in the run's outputs directory that the engine's Petri frontend accepts and, when 'equivalent_to' is set, that has the same places, initial marking, transitions and arcs as that fixture; json_field reads a value from a JSON file in the outputs directory. 'runnable_from' names the build step from which the engine can execute the eval (G0: Petri JSON via the mcd CLI; G1: Promela; G4: ltl/progress; G5: ctl). Corpus fixtures are referenced by path and SHA-256 in evals/fixtures/README.md; evals/fixtures/petrinet1.json is the skill's own encoding, not a corpus copy. Grader: model-check-plugin/evals-workspace/grader.py.

evals.name: mutex-invariant-violated
evals.prompt: Два процесса не должны одновременно попадать в критическую секцию. Проверь эту модель: Promela - examples/CH2/mutex_flaw.pml
evals.expected_output: Invariant violated; status `violated`, evidence `exhaustive`; counterexample decoded through labels L1–L4 with both users at L7; cause class: system defect; the report's engine/inputs sections (manifest) attached; no forbidden phrasing.

assertions.text: The mutual-exclusion property is reported with status violated
The evidence level exhaustive is stated
The counterexample is decoded through the model's labels L1–L4
The counterexample shows both users at label L7 (the critical section)
The cause is classified as a system (algorithm) defect
The engine was invoked (CLI or MCP), not reasoned around
The engine version and input hash (manifest) are quoted
No forbidden phrasing (no errors / proved / system is correct)

evals.name: alternating-bit-liveness-fairness
evals.prompt: Докажи, что alternating bit доставляет каждое сообщение. Модель: Promela - examples/CH3/alternatingbit.pml
evals.expected_output: The fairness question is asked (or an explicit labelled assumption is made) before the liveness run; safety `verified`; liveness reported with a status that depends on the fairness setting, both readings shown as different results; the word "proved" is not used for the model result.

assertions.text: Fairness is raised as a question or as an explicitly labelled assumption before the liveness result
The safety property (no out-of-order acceptance) is reported verified
The liveness result is given both without and with (weak) fairness as two different results
Each liveness result carries an evidence level
The engine was invoked
The word proved/доказано is not used for the model result
No forbidden phrasing

evals.name: petri-net-hang
evals.prompt: Сеть Петри: места p1…p6, переходы t1: p1→p2; t2: p2,p4→p3; t3: p3→p1,p4; t4: p4→p5; t5: p1,p5→p6; t6: p6→p4,p1. Начальная маркировка p1=1, p4=1. Может ли она зависнуть?
evals.expected_output: Petri JSON built to assets/petri-net.schema.json → mcd parse/check --petri → deadlock property `violated`, evidence `exhaustive`; counterexample t1, t4; final marking p2 = p5 = 1; the generated property set (deadlock/hang, safe) reported; 6 reachable markings; CTL vs LTL transition liveness distinguished if asked.

assertions.text: A Petri-net JSON accepted by the engine's frontend was written, with the six places, initial marking p1=p4=1 and the six transitions of the prompt
The engine CLI was run on the net and the command line is shown (mcd check --petri, the binary possibly named through a shell variable)
The hang (deadlock) property is reported with status violated
The evidence level exhaustive is stated
The counterexample is the firing sequence t1 then t4
The final marking has one token in p2 (p2 = 1, or set notation {p2, p5})
The final marking has one token in p5 (p5 = 1, or set notation {p2, p5})
The number of reachable markings (6) is quoted from the engine's counters
The generated safe property is also reported
No forbidden phrasing (no errors / proved / net is correct)

evals.name: telephone-busy-liveness
evals.prompt: Телефон не может зависнуть в состоянии Busy? Модель коммутатора: Promela - examples/CH14/version1
evals.expected_output: Requirement classified as liveness; formalised with a `progress` label or an LTL `<>`/`[]<>` formula on the labels (not on printf output); fairness question asked; status with evidence level reported; if LTL evidence is `unknown`/experimental the report says so.

assertions.text: The requirement is classified as a liveness property
It is formalised as a progress label or an LTL eventually/infinitely-often formula
The formula refers to the model's labels or states (Busy), not to printf output
Fairness is raised before the result
A status from the vocabulary is given
An evidence level is given
No forbidden phrasing

evals.name: c-code-out-of-subset
evals.prompt: Проверь эту модель с c_code: Promela - examples/CH17/simple1.pr
evals.expected_output: Parser rejection explained (c_code/c_expr are outside the subset; no host code is executed); status `not-executed` with the construct and line; no imitation of a result; a rewrite of the C effect as Promela statements offered.

assertions.text: Status not-executed is reported
The rejected construct c_code is named
The rejection is attributed to the parser/frontend (exit code 2 or an explicit rejection)
A source line of the construct is given

No property result is imitated for the original model: no line of the answer attributes verified/violated/inconclusive to simple1.pr, c_code/c_expr or the original (a verdict about a clearly separate rewrite is allowed; iteration-2 refinement, see evals-workspace/iteration-2)
A rewrite of the C effect as Promela statements is offered
No host code is executed and the answer says so

evals.name: ctl-ag-ef-idle
evals.prompt: Проверь свойство AG EF idle на модели Promela - examples/CH14/version1 (idle — метка Idle процесса switch).
evals.expected_output: Checked as CTL through mc_check with the `ctl` property kind; not rewritten into LTL; the branching-time meaning explained; the report says the result is fairness-free and whether the witness is a path or a tree.

assertions.text: The property is handled as CTL
The formula AG EF idle is kept as written
No LTL formula on idle is substituted for it
The branching-time meaning (from every reachable state some path reaches idle) is explained
The result is stated to be fairness-free
The answer says whether the witness or counterexample is a path or a tree
A status from the vocabulary is given
